correctness.rationale: The source definition requires every rank between two and n-1 to distinguish every pair of 2-subsets. The explicit rank-two map f=(0,0,1,1) is therefore enough to refute strong sync-maximality if one pair is not distinguishable. For X={0,1} and Y={2,3}, the proof gives a generator-invariant trichotomy: both images are singletons, the same 2-subset, or complementary 2-subsets. Hence their image cardinalities are always equal under <A4,f>, so precisely-one-singleton separation is impossible. A4 is 2-transitive, hence primitive. The packaged verifier reconstructs all steps and independently exhausts the rank-two and rank-three maps.

value.rationale: The direct source explicitly poses whether strong sync-maximality is properly contained between 4-transitivity and primitivity. The A4 witness resolves one of those two strictness questions globally, not merely for degree four: since A4 is primitive but not strongly sync-maximal, the upper inclusion is proper. The proof is structural and compact, using an invariant on complementary two-subsets rather than a bare finite search.
